subject: Double entries for the same calendar dates in part5

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: Double entries for the same calendar dates in part5
parts:
Hi Vincent and colleagues,

First, thank you for the efforts on improving the GGIR package, and the support given to the community.

We want to analyze the day-to-day estimates of 24-hour movement behaviors based on the output of part5_daysummary_WW csv file. While inspecting the data, we observed double entries for the same calendar dates within several participants, but with different movement estimates. Please see the attached file for an example.

In this file, two participants had double entries for the 2019-17-08 calendar dates. When comparing with the part4 output, the first calendar date was 2019-16-08 and no double entries were observed. We believe this happens when data from part2 and part4 are combined to provide the WW estimates in part5. We appreciate any insights on why this is happening.

Another important question. How is the calendar_date variable identified in part5 WW outputs? Is it based on the date when participants wake up from the previous night?

 

Thank you for your support,

Marcus Lopes, PhD student

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Double entries for the same calendar dates in part5
parts:
This issue should have been fixed in the latest version of GGIR. Which version are you using? If it is the latest - did you reprocess parts 2-5 with that version?

There have been a couple of conversations in this google group around this topic in recent months, e.g. questions from Dora. So, maybe it is easiest if you could checkout those conversations first and see whether you could exchange experiences with her or others.

For me it really helps if people could post a detailed and reproducible example of the issue they are running into, so including sessionInfo() output, R scripts/commands used, and milestone data file.

Calendar date is the date on which the WW window starts.

Best, Vincent



Dr. Vincent van Hees
Independent consultant
https://accelting.com/

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Double entries for the same calendar dates in part5
parts:
Hi Vincent,

We processed the files using GGIR version 2.2-0. Then, we have reprocessed only part2 to include another mvpa threshold to be reported in part2_daysummary_longformat. 
We have checked the discussion on Dora's topic. You presented an example of a situation when this issue may occur in WW output. But in our case, the onset was after midnight in both entries, so we expected to see different calendar dates. 

The metafiles of these two participants are attached to help you with reproducible examples. We also attached the script and sessioninfo() output as .txt files.

Our intention is to model the effect of time-specific PA estimates from p2 on the following night's sleep. So, we need to match part2 daily estimates with part5_WW. The part5_MM sleep estimates are expected to not compute data from the same night and may be inadequate to use. Is this correct?

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Double entries for the same calendar dates in part5
parts:
Thanks Marcus, it was a bug and this should be fixed now.

Can you please try it out?

To use the development version of GGIR with the fix do:

library("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref=issues386_389)
library("GGIR")

This version will be the next release of GGIR. The GitHub-only GGIR release will be next week and the new CRAN release will come a few weeks later.

Thanks,

Vincent
